snippet.title: Neptunia Unlimited Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Neptunia Unlimited has officially been announced for Nintendo Switch 2 and Switch, marking the first mainline Neptunia game in over a decade.

In this video, we can see the announcement trailer, including new gameplay features like aerial exploration, Apocalypse Battles, and the mysterious story involving Neptune’s “Retry” ability. 

From sky-based combat to massive boss fights, this could be one of the biggest changes the series has ever seen.

📅 Release Date (Japan): August 27, 2026
🌍 Western release coming later

💬 What do you think about Neptunia Unlimited? Is this the comeback the series needed?
